abstract: Maintains roadway access verifications and unpaved staging footprint records
system_message:
You are Regional Transport Coordinator (RTC). The Regional Transport Coordinator (RTC) maintains roadway access verifications and unpaved staging footprint records for emergency management evaluations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains roadway access verifications and unpaved staging footprint records（TRFS）
information_points.content:
RTC-TRFS-EH2：For Highland Agricultural Exposition Center, dual-direction arterial access clearance is verified as true, ensuring direct paved connectivity to at least two independent arterial evacuation routes at facility perimeter gate access points. Additionally, the secondary compacted gravel staging yard provides 75 bays of reinforced gravel staging.
RTC-TRFS-6IZ：For Ponderosa Regional Fairgrounds, dual-direction arterial access clearance is verified as true, providing direct paved connectivity to at least two independent arterial evacuation routes at the facility perimeter gate access points. The facility also features 100 bays of reinforced gravel staging in its secondary compacted gravel staging yard, stabilized with a geotextile base for utility vehicles.
RTC-TRFS-GXX：For Timberline Valley Equestrian Park, dual-direction arterial access clearance is verified as false, as perimeter access points lack direct paved connectivity to two independent arterial evacuation routes. The site provides 75 bays of reinforced gravel staging in its secondary compacted gravel staging yard.

information_points.title: Corridor traffic throughput（EVAC）
information_points.content:
RTC-EVAC-ADD：At Timberline Valley Equestrian Park, traffic flow modeling at the primary egress intersection indicates a peak hourly vehicle discharge rate of 300 vehicles/h under traffic control direction during outbound surges.
RTC-EVAC-NT1：At Highland Agricultural Exposition Center, the peak hourly vehicle discharge rate measured at the primary egress intersection during outbound surges is 450 vehicles/h under traffic control direction.
RTC-EVAC-7WE：At Ponderosa Regional Fairgrounds, the primary egress intersection demonstrates a peak hourly vehicle discharge rate of 600 vehicles/h under traffic control direction during outbound surges.
